{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjqe88AAAABZl85Pg", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3INzhDMfQw", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3IN", "number": 127, "title": "Reconcile MAIN provenance with the dated July 1996 walkthrough", "body": "## Problem

At baseline `b44a7debd0780517c21703e69377d8d579af96e5`, `data/pcvan/main-1996.json` attributes MAIN exclusively to a retrospective reproduction. The research document likewise describes its selected entries as category C evidence without recording newly located contemporary structural corroboration.

The previous assessment also described OSL/ODL identifiers as readable in the new source. Current live extraction does not substantiate that description: later headings and Japanese labels are damaged. Recording inferred readings as directly observed text would give future implementation work excessive confidence.

## Expected outcome

Add a bounded, source-specific provenance reconciliation to the existing fixture metadata and research document. Explain what the dated source corroborates, what remains unreadable, and which existing presentation choices remain reconstructed. Preserve current service behavior and literal fixture values.

This is a concrete prerequisite for evaluating future MAIN/LIFE and file-catalog journeys. Successful Japanese recovery is not a completion gate.

## Context

### Historical evidence

Inspected on 2026-10-24:

- [Participant walkthrough](https://www.cis.twcu.ac.jp/~k-oda/AccessBlind/yuasa.html), explicitly updated July 26, 1996: shows eleven paired MAIN rows followed by a standalone row; ASCII inputs `12 → 10 → 6 → 7 → 1 → 2`; readable `SEIKATSU,LIFE`, `BORANTEA`, and `VOLUNTEER` markers; and subsequent filename/date/numeric catalog rows. Japanese extraction is damaged. Exact later headings, field labels and geometry remain unverified. High confidence in visible structure and ASCII observations; moderate confidence in historical applicability because preservation and dating are not independently authenticated.
- [Paradise Army reproduction](https://paradisearmy.com/doujin/pasok3pc-van.htm): its circa-1996 example remains the readable basis for the selected labels and full-width typography. It is retrospective, carries a December 1999 credit, and supplies no authenticated revision chronology.

HTTPS and HTTP extraction produced the same damage. The alternate university hostname was inaccessible. Browser-based decoding inspection was unavailable under tool approval restrictions; no bypass was attempted. Retain these limitations without requiring another identical retrieval attempt.

Treat the walkthrough as category A preserved period documentation within its stated scope. Keep category C attribution for labels taken from the reproduction and category D attribution for the current 44-cell offset. July evidence does not establish November continuity, particularly for seasonal entries. Another SIG’s catalog cannot establish DAISIZEN procedures.

### Implementation and duplication evidence

- `src/navigation.ts:renderMain` already renders consecutive pairs with reconstructed display-cell padding. `tests/navigation.spec.ts` covers grouping, literal labels, returns, reconnect and narrow-terminal scrolling.
- `src/sections.ts` still maps MAIN 12 to an empty article collection. Record that discrepancy as a future behavior candidate; implementing it is outside this Issue.
- README’s introduction and the research document’s Source assessment, Fixtures and boundaries, and MAIN display reconstruction sections need consistent qualification. Existing About output already links to the research document.
- [Completed Issue #57](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/issues/57) implemented MAIN presentation using the reproduction. This Issue reconciles additional evidence rather than repeating that implementation.
- Live repository-scoped open-item searches returned no Issues or PRs. Bounded history searches for MAIN display, Yuasa, July and LIFE found no equivalent handoff; lexical searches are incomplete.
- [PR #126](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/pull/126) and `docs/validation.md` report 519 passing checks with three workers, including configured type checking/build. Those are Coordinator records, not checks executed by this research graph. They do not validate this proposed correction.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Add one minimal container-level corroborating-source record to `data/pcvan/main-1996.json`, containing URL, inspection date, claimed historical date, supported observations and limitations. Preserve the existing primary transcription source and avoid upgrading every entry to category A or verified status.
- [ ] Update the research sections identified above and README’s introductory qualification. Clearly distinguish direct observations, qualified interpretations, unreadable text and implementation assumptions. Keep earlier evidence and failed-retrieval findings available.
- [ ] Record the source-local route and catalog observations once in the research document. Explicitly qualify the earlier OSL/ODL readability claim and unknown numeric-field meanings/units. Do not fill unreadable Japanese using the reproduction or infer transfer, approval, paging, pricing or return commands.
- [ ] Record the MAIN 12 placeholder as a bounded future discrepancy, with the readable secondary-label evidence still needed before a faithful route implementation. Do not add services, archived files, identities, messages or screenshots.
- [ ] Keep selectors, labels, order, prompt text, existing entry source/status fields, renderer behavior and navigation unchanged. Preserve all existing functional, storage, consent, IME and terminal regression coverage.
- [ ] Parse the changed JSON using existing Node or Python facilities and compare its operational fields against the baseline fixture. Review Markdown syntax, local links/anchors, evidence-category consistency and `git diff --check`. Review the complete diff for metadata/documentation-only scope and record actual results in the PR.
- [ ] No application build/test suite is required for this metadata/documentation-only change. Do not add a new framework or evidence subsystem. If implementation scope changes, revise the Issue’s acceptance before proceeding.

## Optional validation

A permitted read-only recovery of original encoding may strengthen individual observations. Record the method and confidence if successful; otherwise retain the bounded unreadable-text finding. Former-user, hardware and subjective checks are not required.

## Required post-merge verification

None required.
